desc: Audit and decide the single-owner handoff for T6040 PCIe port 1, DART1, GL9755 SDHCI, clocks/resets, and the permitted gP19 endpoint-power GPIO before m1n1 enters U-Boot. Grounding: completed ticket 128, ROADMAP §§B/D/H, the GL9755 wiring in dts/t6040-j614s-dcuart-pcie.dts, and the PCIe double-initialization/SError correction recorded in DEVLOG. Trace current m1n1 pcie_init/shutdown and U-Boot pcie_apple/pci_mmc paths; deliver an ADT/DTS-derived register/resource matrix, a no-double-init contract, and narrowly scoped patch drafts or a no-go. No rig, blind MMIO, SPMI, or unallowlisted SMC writes.
author: sol
